title: A finished worker's worktree is not left locked
goal: After a kb-worker agent returns, its worktree under .claude/worktrees/ can be removed with git worktree remove without unlocking it first, so backlog.py land and the sprint close cleanup run without a manual unlock

gates.question: When land finds the branch in a finished worker's worktree under .claude/worktrees/ that Claude Code left locked (reason starting 'claude agent') and that has no uncommitted changes, does land unlock and remove it itself, or only refuse and name the unlock and remove commands?
options: auto-unlock: land unlocks and removes it (never --force) and reports that it did
name only: land refuses as before and names git worktree unlock and git worktree remove for that path
gates.recommendation: auto-unlock: land unlocks and removes it (never --force) and reports that it did
gates.answer: auto-unlock: land unlocks and removes it (never --force) and reports that it did
